name: How long does the custom luxury pool design and construction process typically take?
description: The process, from design to completion, typically takes 5-8 months, depending on design complexity, site conditions, and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does the custom luxury pool design and construction process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom luxury pool project can vary significantly based on the complexity of the design, site conditions, permitting requirements, and material availability. Generally, the design phase can take 4-8 weeks, followed by 2-4 weeks for permitting. Construction itself typically ranges from 12 to 24 weeks, but larger or more intricate projects with extensive hardscaping or automation can extend beyond this. We provide a detailed project timeline during the initial consultation once the design scope is understood.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process, from design to completion, typically takes 5-8 months, depending on design complexity, site conditions, and permitting.
